headline: Results beat guidance as AI-driven demand accelerates
summary_short: KLA reported fiscal Q4 2026 (our shard label: FY2026 Q2) revenue of $3.658 billion, up 15.2% y/y, with GAAP diluted EPS of $1.04 (+14.3% y/y) and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.05, both landing at the upper end of the company's own guidance range.
summary_long: Revenue of $3.658B topped the midpoint of guidance on 13% y/y growth in the core Semiconductor Process Control segment and a 56% y/y rebound in PCB and Component Inspection. GAAP diluted EPS of $1.04 and non-GAAP EPS of $1.05 landed at the upper end of guidance, though GAAP gross margin (~61.4%) was roughly flat to down slightly y/y. Operating cash flow was $906M and free cash flow $817M for the quarter; KLA returned $876M to shareholders via buybacks and dividends. Cash fell to $1.650B from $1.787B q/q on capital returns and investing activity. KLA initiated Q1 FY2027 guidance: revenue $4.0B +/- $200M and GAAP diluted EPS $1.14 +/- $0.10.

drivers.explanation: CEO said growth trends are strengthening into the second half of calendar 2026, citing AI infrastructure buildout driving demand for process control across foundry/logic, memory, and advanced packaging.
Semiconductor Process Control grew 13% y/y to $3.257B; PCB and Component Inspection rebounded 56% y/y to $241M, the fastest-growing of the three reporting segments.
Gross profit dollars rose with revenue, but GAAP gross margin was roughly flat-to-down (about 61.4% vs 62.0% a year ago) as cost of revenues grew slightly faster than sales.
Net income grew roughly in line with operating income; the effective tax rate rose to about 12.0% from 9.5% a year ago, a modest offset to margin gains.
